description: Fork only (see FORK.md): enforce the feature loop when the repo (or its main worktree) has .scratch/gates.json without status closed. PreToolUse on Bash gates git commit (slop in the staged lines), git push and PR creation (build-phase gates; pushes to the base branch refused) and gh pr merge or a GraphQL mergePullRequest (match-head-commit, merge-phase gates, green CI on that sha, HEAD equal to that sha); fails closed while a loop is active. Stop refuses to end a turn while a stage is running. SessionStart summarizes where the loop stands.
